verdict.rationale: OpenHands has commercial Cloud and Enterprise plans, so plan-based limits are a fair axis to judge. However, the pricing evidence only lists features (hosted access, API support, SSO, bring-your-own keys) and never mentions daily task quotas or concurrency caps, let alone a way to view or manage them. SDK-level parallel execution via asyncio.gather is a developer building block, not a plan-limit management capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
